players.product: power cable (LV / MV / HV) and busduct, including via US subsidiary LS Cable & System U.S.A. (LSCUS)

quarterly_data.signal: US subsidiary LSCUS signed a large busduct supply contract with a US AI cloud operator: a total of KRW 200 billion (2,000 hundred-million won) of busducts for a US AI cloud data center project, supplied sequentially through 2027. The project includes a 250MW-class AI data center, the largest single building among data centers LSCUS has supplied, and extends LSCUS's customer base from global big tech and generative AI companies to AI cloud operators. Additional projects of 2 to 3 times the contracted volume are under discussion.
quarterly_data.figure: KRW 200 billion (2,000 hundred-million won); supply through 2027; 250MW-class data center; further projects 2-3 times the contract volume under discussion

quarterly_data.signal: In step with LSCUS order growth, LS Cable & System is expanding busduct production capacity: once the Gumi (Gyeongbuk) plant expansion and the Mexico production subsidiary are completed at the end of this year, capacity is expected to grow to about 3 times the current level. CEO Chung Hyun: the growing scale and density of AI data centers makes power distribution infrastructure more important, and Gaon Cable will strengthen its push into the North American AI data center market with a portfolio spanning busduct and MV cable.
quarterly_data.figure: busduct capacity about 3 times current after the year-end completions
